meaning: Published EGP prices for specific procurement candidates; not supplier quotations or engineering approval. Product-page and search-snippet evidence are distinguished. Tax treatment is as displayed by each supplier; no common tax rate is assumed.

B02.spec: JSN-SR04T, SKU EW-25041; exact revision to confirm
B02.notes: Price verified on product page. Only probe is weather resistant; verify blind zone and board protection.

B04.spec: 4.7k ohm 0.5W through-hole; substitutes the original 0.25W pull-up
B04.notes: Higher power rating does not change the intended pull-up resistance.

B09.notes: Product fetch timed out; price from indexed supplier listing. Listed Voc is 7.2V: do not connect to the draft TP4056 circuit without checking/replacing the charger and input protection. Final power sizing unresolved.

B11.spec: One 5x20 external holder plus one 3A glass fuse, provisional rating
B11.notes: 10.00 holder + 0.75 fuse = 10.75 EGP. Fuse source: https://www.ram-e-shop.com/shop/fuse3a-glass-fuse-short-3a-250v-size-t5x20mm-5997 . Final fuse rating/interrupt capacity must follow measured current and cell/wire protection design.

B12.spec: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 LDO candidate, SOT-23-5; needs supporting components and thermal/dropout validation
B12.notes: Published per-regulator price, excluding VAT. Verify peak current, dropout/cell cutoff and required capacitors from manufacturer datasheet; candidate only.

B15.spec: 2N7000 N-channel TO-92 gate driver, two per bin
B15.notes: Gate pull-up/down resistors remain in B05. Check exact transistor pinout and operation at 3.3V on bench.

B16.spec: 100uF 6.3V radial capacitor candidate; seller describes low ESR
B16.notes: Seller description is not an ESR guarantee. Verify a named manufacturer's ESR, ripple and temperature data against the modem hardware guide; increase/substitute if needed. Modem burst stability remains untested.

B18.spec: SIM7600E-H LTE Cat-4 HAT with antennas; reference alternative only
B18.notes: Excluded from bin total. This is a full Raspberry Pi HAT, not a low-cost Cat-1 module or drop-in ESP32 replacement; power/interface integration must be redesigned. Seek a Cat-1 quote before choosing LTE.

B19.spec: Plus 1400 MB listed 37 EGP per 28 days; normalized monthly reference
B19.notes: Published bundle price is 37 EGP/28 days, not 37/calendar month. Annualized monthly equivalent = 37*365/28/12 = 40.19 EGP, rounded. SIM activation, required base plan, recharge taxes and IoT/APN terms are not quoted or included; this is not a business IoT offer.

B20.spec: 200x120x55mm project box; fit and assembled sealing to verify
B20.notes: Candidate must fit board, antenna, cable bend radius and protected cell. No certified assembled IP rating claimed.

B22.spec: Amphenol VENT-PS1YBK-N8001 M12 breathable vent with nut
B22.notes: Supplier displays 339.00 ex VAT and 389.85 inc VAT; use its displayed inclusive amount, do not infer a tax rate. Mounting and assembled ingress protection remain to verify.

B23.spec: 20-piece set M6x20 A2/304 pin-Torx security screws; one set
B23.notes: Price for one fastener set; verify thread size, nuts, driver bit and mounting compatibility.

B25.notes: Supplier displays 2046.00 ex VAT and 2352.90 inc VAT. Whole bottle counted for one-off procurement; shared use lowers allocated cost but no coverage yield is invented. Follow manufacturer application and masking instructions.

B26.spec: One purchased set of 30 x 10g sachets
B26.notes: Price for one 30-sachet set. Required quantity and replacement interval are not measured.

B27.spec: 2m AWG22 silicone wire + two LD20 2-pin inline connector sets; example power-wiring basket
B27.notes: 2*30 EGP wire + 2*240 EGP connectors = 540. Sensor cables pass through B21 glands; these two-pin connectors are for power only. Connector source: https://www.ram-e-shop.com/shop/ld20-2pin-ld20-docking-ip67-2pin-waterproof-dustproof-connector-water-depth-1m-9045 . Check cable seal diameter and current. Extra sensor/control leads, heatshrink and ferrules are not fully itemized.

B28.notes: Candidate perfboard, not a finished field PCB. SMD regulator requires an appropriate carrier/layout; include that quote after choosing the power circuit.

unpriced.B24: Custom bin-lid bracket and sensor mount: exact dimensions and a workshop quote are required. No finished CAD or verifiable price was found; no real price can be invented.
